entities.name: Félix Verdejo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félix Giomar Verdejo Sánchez is a Puerto Rican former professional boxer and convicted murderer. As an amateur he represented Puerto Rico at the 2012 Olympics. Between 2012 and 2020 Verdejo competed professionally for Top Rank and held the WBO Latino lightweight title from 2015 to 2017.
